lastCompletedStory.title: Compilar os quatro alvos a partir de um host unico e publica-los como assets de um Release marcado prerelease

nextStoryContext: scripts/build-release.sh now cross-compiles all four release targets (bun-darwin-arm64, bun-darwin-x64, bun-linux-x64, bun-linux-arm64) from a single macOS host in one run, writing dist/gateship-<os>-<arch> for each; the old single dist/cam-darwin-arm64 artifact name is retired. Only the host-native artifact (resolved via uname -s/-m) is executed for the --version smoke and the hermetic `cam init` soft-check (CAM-15 lineage: mktemp -d cwd, --no-tmux, absolute BIN_ABS path) -- the other three cross-compiled binaries cannot run on the build host and are never executed by this script; a caller verifies their machine code with `file`. codesign (ad-hoc re-sign + verify) runs only for the two bun-darwin-* outputs; ELF/linux artifacts are never signed. `--install` is now additive and writes TWO fixed filenames, `gateship` and `gship`, into dirname(INSTALL_DEST) (or ~/.local/bin when --install is passed bare) -- the script never removes a pre-existing `cam` binary (ADR-0055). Verified live end-to-end on this Mac arm64 host: all 4 artifacts built and passed `file` architecture checks (darwin-arm64 Mach-O arm64 61MB, darwin-x64 Mach-O x86_64 66MB, linux-x64 ELF x86-64 98MB, linux-arm64 ELF aarch64 98MB), and a hermetic `--install "$D/gateship"` run produced both `$D/gateship` and `$D/gship` as working executables with no `rm ... cam` anywhere in the script. New `.github/workflows/release.yml` triggers on `tags: v*`, builds via `bun run build:release` on macos-latest, and runs `gh release create "${{ github.ref_name }}" dist/gateship-* --prerelease --generate-notes` using the ambient `${{ github.token }}` (no new secret needed); this workflow is intentionally NOT added to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` because `scripts/check-ci-parity.ts`'s CI_YML_PATH only ever reads ci.yml, so a release-only workflow is structurally invisible to that parity gate and must stay that way. README.md's from-source Install section and the Development section's build:release comment were updated to the new gateship-* artifact names and the gateship/gship install targets (surgical accuracy fix only -- the larger lead-with-packaged-install README rewrite plus the curl-able installer is explicitly US-004/US-005 scope per the PRD notes, not touched here). The artifact naming convention (gateship-darwin-arm64, gateship-darwin-x64, gateship-linux-x64, gateship-linux-arm64) is exactly what the next story (curl-able installer) needs to construct its download URL against https://github.com/eduardocaminha/cam-cli/releases/download/<tag>/<asset>.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed --target=bun-<os>-<arch> is the documented cross-compile flag and the four triples used (bun-darwin-arm64, bun-darwin-x64, bun-linux-x64, bun-linux-arm64) are exactly the ones the docs list; confirmed codesign on macOS is a manual post-build step (`codesign --force --sign -`), matching the existing ad-hoc re-sign already in the script.
